generations.prompt:
Redraw the water effect in the attached legacy strip for a polished playful bubble game. Output: ONE ultra-wide horizontal RGBA water-surface tile, transparent background, no scene, no labels, no panels. First reference = old effect ONLY for its general horizontal purpose, replace its fluffy white puffs and repeated identical spirals completely. Second reference = the game's soap bubble, use its sharp crescent highlight, thin pearly skin and see-through middle ONLY on the few tiny bubbles. Third reference = level of finish on specular details, not its gold color or sweeping silhouette.

Stage W1, a gentle wall of transparent cartoon water JUST WELLING UP. Front view, orthographic 2D light-3D game sprite. A continuous shallow dynamic waterline travels from the LEFT EDGE through the RIGHT EDGE, horizontally repeating like a 1D game tileset. Both ends intersect the side edges at the exact same height through a quiet, nearly flat stretch with moderate transparency: water continues beyond both boundaries, no tapered end caps. Crest stays within a shallow band, approximately y=25..55 on a 1080x180 final canvas (y grows downward). A little right-facing hooked water lip near x=250, a long low convex shoulder sliding into a shallow hollow around x=560, then one smaller lifted ripple near x=810. Unequal sizes, heights and spacing. A real but gentle WATER WAVE. NO row of identical breaking curls. Fluid asymmetric stretches between crests, transparent wedges and curved refractive streaks in the liquid. Silhouette crisp, silky, rounded edges. A few short clean milk-white foam fillets and slim glossy white highlights trace the upper lip over an icy blue under-edge. Small wet folds have volume. Underneath, a continuous VERY translucent pale-aqua body (light #BFE8FF), even more transparent toward bottom until entirely transparent, without a hard horizontal bottom edge. Use subtle contiguous transparent layers, fluid optical refraction and *limited* caustics, no busy detail/noisiness. A few tiny transparent bubble pinheads tucked near the lip. Overall quiet, soft in opacity but sharply drawn: this lies over colorful puzzle pieces at half opacity. No broad white froth, fog, smoke, clouds, cotton balls, photorealistic ocean, violent splash, fountains, surf illustration, outlined comic scene, dark navy shadows, gold, beach, horizon, ground plane, large bubbles, stars, border, text, foreground scenery or extra objects. Maximum wide landscape, one uninterrupted tile. Plenty of genuinely transparent pixels above surface and beneath fading water.

Paint ONE transparent side-scrolling game VFX tile. The first attached sprite is stage W1 and is the animation registration and style reference. Advance this same wave by one animation phase as described below. Keep the same shallow horizontal waterline and same asymmetrical layout: principal little breaking crest in left quarter, an extended convex shoulder to its right, quiet open trough beyond center, and smaller raised lip in right quarter. Water must flow across both side edges at matching heights and with matching color and slope. Full bleed straight-through left/right, genuine RGBA transparency above and below. Front view of a shallow cross section, clean glossy gently stylized cartoon liquid with a thin white refracting upper rim, pale cool blue optical edge, a translucent #BFE8FF body fading downwards. Game pieces behind the effect must remain legible. IMPORTANT: second reference is the visual design for *tiny* soap bubbles only. Translucent thin pearly film, see-through centers, little white crescent highlights, very understated iridescence. Vary the tiny bubble sizes in small irregular clusters. The bubble rims, water glints, and folds should be clean edged, not blurred white mist. No cloud humps or smoke, white cotton foam, identical copy-pasted curl motifs, high contrast masses, starbursts, saturated rainbow paint, realistic spray, deep ocean, text, border or floor. Ultra-wide landscape, the same framing as input. Final intended 1080x180, keep crest around final y40, shallow local rises/falls.
W2 CREST TURNS OVER. The lip around left quarter curls forward more decisively and begins to break; its highlight peels into a few separate white little arcs and detached beads of clean foam. Elsewhere the long raised shoulder softly slips forward, breaks into fragments differently than the main curl. The right crest makes a modest smaller flick. Use about 8–14 small lightweight translucent soap-bubbles, with varied scale and gaps and two or three very tiny higher motes. Keep most close to the water. Show some delicately drawn refractive facets beneath the active lip so it has WATER volume. This is a subtle push, not a big splash. A little more lively than phase 1, still gentle. The body thins and becomes more transparent toward the bottom. Side edges connect through a calm waterline.

Paint ONE transparent side-scrolling game VFX tile. The first attached sprite is stage W1 and is the animation registration and style reference. Advance this same wave by one animation phase as described below. Keep the same shallow horizontal waterline and same asymmetrical layout: principal little breaking crest in left quarter, an extended convex shoulder to its right, quiet open trough beyond center, and smaller raised lip in right quarter. Water must flow across both side edges at matching heights and with matching color and slope. Full bleed straight-through left/right, genuine RGBA transparency above and below. Front view of a shallow cross section, clean glossy gently stylized cartoon liquid with a thin white refracting upper rim, pale cool blue optical edge, a translucent #BFE8FF body fading downwards. Game pieces behind the effect must remain legible. IMPORTANT: second reference is the visual design for *tiny* soap bubbles only. Translucent thin pearly film, see-through centers, little white crescent highlights, very understated iridescence. Vary the tiny bubble sizes in small irregular clusters. The bubble rims, water glints, and folds should be clean edged, not blurred white mist. No cloud humps or smoke, white cotton foam, identical copy-pasted curl motifs, high contrast masses, starbursts, saturated rainbow paint, realistic spray, deep ocean, text, border or floor. Ultra-wide landscape, the same framing as input. Final intended 1080x180, keep crest around final y40, shallow local rises/falls.
W3 SETTLES AND EVAPORATES. There is almost no water body left: a few very faint pale cyan wisps at the original surface, its once-substantial crest now broken into small spaced glossy white line segments. The THREE formerly raised areas flatten, leaving one connected suggestion of the old waterline across the edges for tiling. Make the dominant remaining features a handful of detached tiny, hollow soap bubbles floating upwards above where the surface had been. Scatter them unevenly, with 3–4 higher individuals and a few near-surface tiny clusters. At delivery size, tiny bubbles mostly 2–9 px; do not draw a row of identical pearls. Huge clear spaces, the ground and pieces behind show through. Breath of aqua where the water was. Do NOT retain the full-density stripe from stage 1. Faint final decay, not the initial wave again. Use authentic semitransparency.

Refine this last fading animation frame into an exceptionally clean isolated transparent sprite. Remove the white gauze above the surface and almost all of the continuous opaque water body. Keep the few hollow translucent soap bubbles, with pearly film and crisp white glints. They should be visibly separated by CLEAR TRANSPARENT AIR. Reduce the height of the highest floating bubble so the group stays fairly close to the former surface, keep substantial empty spaces. Preserve the same horizontal registration, the little softened lip near the left quarter and lower ripple near the right quarter. The remnants of the upper rim must be VISIBLY BROKEN with several unequal quiet gaps: a short tapering wet glint here, a small arc of fizz there. The two side edges need only a whisper of a connected pale cyan waterline at the same height for seamless wrapping. Very slight #BFE8FF tint of remaining water directly under it, dying down to completely transparent. No sheet of milk, mist, watercolor backdrop, volumetric glow, cloud, large wave, spray, repeated curls, white band, or rectangular plate. Upmarket simple soft cartoon clear liquid, a quiet last phase at fade-out, artwork only on alpha channel with large areas of real transparency. Very wide strip, exactly one tile with no labels and no borders.

export.notes: 浪体与泡沫取自采用的生成原图。对齐浪顶，水体沿深度渐隐；小泡保留原图虹彩和亮面并作等比采样。左右接缝在预乘 alpha 下用周期重叠区平滑过渡。
